documentation.description:
Configures the SPI peripheral and GPIO pins.
Raises Constraint_Error if pins do not belong to the same SPI.

subprograms.name: Exchange

documentation.description:
Transmits TX and receives into RX.

NOTE: This is NOT a true full-duplex SPI transfer.
The RP2040 HAL does not expose a native full-duplex routine.
This is implemented as separate Transmit followed by Receive.
Received bytes during Transmit are discarded.
The SPI FIFO is 8 bytes deep; for larger transfers use the
HAL directly.
